description: Render an Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundle as a single self-contained, interactive HTML graph (viz.html) — concepts as nodes coloured by type and sized by body length, markdown links and bundle-internal `sources` as edges, a wiki-style detail panel with rendered markdown, v0.2 trust/lifecycle/provenance metadata, and "Links to" / "Cited by" backlinks, layout switching, per-type filter and search. Use when asked to visualize, graph, preview, or explore an OKF bundle.
